LESSON: MILAD UN-NABI

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.1: Milad un-Nabi

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Milad un-Nabi. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: When was the Prophet 7. 0 ISLAMIC learner should be able to: praise of the Prophet (S.A.W). (S.A.W) born?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Appreciate Aqiqah as an Islamic ritual for all children

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: MILAD UN-NABI
This lesson teaches Milad un-Nabi for Grade 2 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. Appreciate Aqiqah as an Islamic ritual for all children
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Milad un-Nabi using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Milad un-Nabi above.
2. Explain Milad un-Nabi to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Milad un-Nabi.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Milad un-Nabi with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Milad un-Nabi important for a Grade 2 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. When was the Prophet 7. 0 ISLAMIC learner should be able to: praise of the Prophet (S.A.W). (S.A.W) born?
2. when a place during Aqiqah ceremony Aqiqah ceremony. baby is born?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Appreciate Aqiqah as an Islamic ritual for all children
